_comment: Model/provider fields are generated by bin/apply_profile.py from harness.toml + profiles/. Everything else is hand-written and preserved across `make profile`.

critic.description: Adversarial reviewer. Hunts silent regressions in a diff. Never edits, never proposes fixes.

scribe.description: Mechanical documentation: changelogs, docstrings, README tables. No logic changes.

check.template: Run `make check`. If it fails, fix the smallest thing that makes it pass, then re-run. Do not edit evals/snapshots/ or raise a budget to pass. Report each fix in one line.

review.template: Run `git diff` against the base branch, then hand the diff to the @critic subagent. Report the critic's findings verbatim, then state which you agree with and which you don't, with reasons.

handoff.template: Follow skills/ship/SKILL.md. Commit on the branch and push for review.

context.template: Run `make context`. If the always-on budget is exceeded, propose what to cut — moving a procedure from AGENTS.md into a skill is almost always the answer. Do not raise the budget without saying why in the same message.

_generated_by_apply_profile.note: Generated. Edit harness.toml or profiles/, then `make profile`.
